{{Top|notoc=1}} {{Otheruses|unidentified stormtrooper}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:SarlaccTrooper-BoBFCh1.png]] |name=Unidentified stormtrooper
(Great Pit of Carkoon) |homeworld= |birth= |death=By [[4 ABY]], [[Tatooine]][[Boba Fett]] falls into the [[sarlacc]] during the [[rescue of Han Solo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]], meaning that the [[stormtrooper]] already present in the [[Species|creature's]] [[stomach]] must have [[Death|died]] by that [[Standard year|year]]. |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia, New Edition]]'' establishes that the [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire]] were all [[human]]s. |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]]{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} **[[Stormtrooper Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} A [[human]] '''stormtrooper''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] was active on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] until eventually [[Death|falling]] into the [[sarlacc]] of the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. In [[4 ABY]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] fell into the pit and later used the [[oxygen]] tubes within the [[trooper]]'s [[Stormtrooper armor|helmet]] to supply [[Gender|himself]] long enough to escape from the [[Stomach|belly]] of the [[Species|sarlacc]], which he ultimately did. ==Behind the scenes== The stormtrooper appears as a corpse in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|first episode]] of the [[2021]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', serving as a means of explaining how Fett escaped his fate from the [[1983]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi]]''. ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} {{1st}} {{Corpse}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი შტურმტრუპერი (კარკუნის დიდი ორმო) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
